3. And the controlled stale grid exposes Category record 901 owned by "OTHER_ADMIN"
4. And Admin A has no "OTHER_ADMIN" entitlement
5. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Audit" in the Category grid row with "Record Id" "901"
6. Then the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar displays the agreed audit access-denial message
